notes.title: Victory Day! (update and discount)
notes.content:
Happy Victory Day, comrades!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25744929/d1aa51b7a392160e9d2e0bbf2df78cbb571768e8.png[/img]

To commemorate the Soviet Union's Victory in the Great Patriotic War of 1941-1945, the update was released.
[list]
List of changes:
[*] the lamp is replaced for TV translating the Victory Parade for the duration of the holidays;
[*] Stalin now is in his full formal uniform for the duration of the holidays;
[*] arms reach is increased to improve grabbing distant items;
[*] minor items balance.
[/list]
Also, enjoy the 45% off discount during May 5-9th!

notes.title: Christmas and New Year update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The New Year mode is enabled from Dec, 22 and until Jan, 7!
Stalin now has a Christmas tree, a new hat and he's drinking champagne instead of vodka to celebrate the New Year!
[*]Fixed bug with the Endless mode
[/list]

notes.title: Thanksgiving update!
notes.content:
American colleagues sent us a present. Of course their imperialist holidays are completely alien to our people. But I will not refuse a good turkey! The question is, can we trust them?

[list]
[*]added a new seasonal hat and a Thanksgiving Turkey item - eat it to reduce stress but be prepared to throw it away if something goes wrong!
[*]few minor balance tweaks
[/list]

Edit:
[list]
[*]it is now easier to see that you can disable the Thanksgiving mode in the main menu
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
The game has been updated to version 1.0.3.

Changes:
[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug where the phone would jump away from the hand by itself, leaving it in a glitched state.
    [*]The phone now resets itself onto the base more accurately.
    [*]Removed some of the gun targets at the bottom of the screen where it's hardest to aim.
    [*]Items now stuck out of reach of Stalin's hands less often.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
The game has been updated to version 1.0.2. 

Changes:

[list]
Endless mode:
    [*] Stamps are enabled in Endless mode now.
    [*] Failing state activity in Endless mode makes the clock run faster.
    [*] Added score to the Endless mode. Earn points by doing state activity like answering phone and using stamps. There is no global leaderboard at this point.
    [*] Added new achievement: earn 10,000 points in the Endless mode.

Fixes and balance:
    [*] State Integrity bonus for phone conversations is now granted gradually during the call instead of at the end.
    [*] It is now easier to pick up the vodka glass.
    [*] Rare bug that caused saves to corrupt after completing the game should be fixed now. Old corrupted saves should work properly after this fix.
[/list] 
Edit:
1.0.2a was released, the vodka glitch is now hopefully fixed.
